title: Raising HTTP Exceptions 🚨
ques: Write a route `/items/{item_id}` that raises an `HTTPException` with status code 404 and detail `"Item not found"` if `item_id` is greater than 100.
explanation: Raising `HTTPException` halts the function execution immediately and sends the specified HTTP status and error message to the client.

title: Custom Exception Handlers 🛠
ques: Write a custom exception handler for `ValueError` that catches the error globally and returns a JSON response with status 400 and the error message.
explanation: Exception handlers allow you to catch standard Python exceptions globally and format them into standardized API error responses.

title: Testing with TestClient 🧪
ques: Write a basic unit test using `TestClient` to test the `/hello` route, asserting that the status code is 200.
explanation: `TestClient` allows you to write synchronous tests for your FastAPI app easily, similar to how you would test a standard requests-based client.
